request.style: English, classic soul ballad, smooth expressive female vocal, Rhodes electric piano, lush strings, warm bass, soft drums, tender and soaring, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I could sing like the angels
I could speak in every tongue
But without love I'm a clanging gong
A song that's never sung
I could move every mountain
Give away all that I own
But without love I gain nothing
I'm standing here alone

[Chorus]
Love is patient, love is kind
Keeps no record of wrongs
It bears all things, believes all things
Hopes all things, endures all things
Love never ends

[Verse]
When I was a child I spoke like a child
Thought the way that children do
Now we see a dim reflection in a mirror
But then face to face with you

[Chorus]
Love is patient, love is kind
Keeps no record of wrongs
It bears all things, believes all things
Hopes all things, endures all things
Love never ends

[Bridge]
Faith and hope and love remain
These three, these three
But the greatest of these
The greatest of these is love

[Outro]
Love never ends
Love never ends
